EU-PEARL templates as data

On this page: MPT and ISA side by side · Title page and synopsis fields · Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) · Data Monitoring Committee charter (DMC)

The EU-PEARL suite of platform-trial templates (eu-pearl.eu; the rationale is published in Trials, 2024), read by script as documents with their own structure. What is shown is the structure: headings, field labels, and per section the number of paragraphs of each text kind, from the templates' own styles and markers. No paragraph text is shown: the templates are © EU-PEARL Consortium, the MPT, ISA and SAP based on TransCelerate templates, all rights reserved.

  • MPT: 1.EU-PEARL_MPT-Template_V4-25April2023.docx (133 sections)
  • ISA: 2.EU-PEARL_ISA-Template-V4-25April2023.docx (100 sections)
  • SAP: 3.EU-PEARL_SAP_Template_V3-25April2023.docx (42 sections)
  • DMC: 4.EU-PEARL_DMC-CHarter-Template-V1-25April2023.docx (46 sections)
  • CTR: 5.EU-PEARL-Guidance-to-CTR-Cover-letter-V4_25April2023.docx (no heading tree; not rendered here)

Text kinds: instruction (instruction style), common, suggested, example, sample (the templates' start and end markers), guidance (DMC charter), field label. EU-PEARL change: characters highlighted as changed from the TransCelerate template. How they were read: README.

section keys (document:paragraph) and field positions; the alignment key shows on hover over the relation

MPT and ISA side by side

Sections matched on the exact normalised title path, no fuzzy matching: 90 in both, 43 in the MPT only, 10 in the ISA only (placed after the ISA section they follow). For a matched section, the ISA relation is set only where an explicit phrase occurs in the ISA section: no explicit master reference 35; refers to master + extends master 31; refers to master 18; refers to master + either location 3; extends master 3. The phrase is kept as evidence in mpt_isa_alignment.csv.
